source.stem:
The engine of a motor vehicle develops a large amount of power.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The driving force acting on the vehicle must be large.
The engine must have a very large volume.
The engine must transfer large amounts of energy each second.
The vehicle must be very fast.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: flat transparent glass is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The decision still holds even if we ignore this condition: Through a flat transparent glass window pane, objects look the same size and shape.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: This rule applies even when Through a flat transparent glass window pane, objects look the same size and shape is not true.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Judge from the most visible feature in the figure, not from the mechanism's test.

intelligence.enrichment: A flat transparent glass pane leaves objects looking the same size and shape; a convex lens can make a nearby object appear erect and enlarged, while lens type and distance change the appearance of the object seen through it. transparent surface shape and object distance determine the apparent size and orientation seen through the material The learner predicts how objects appear through a convex lens, concave lens, or flat transparent glass piece using shape and distance. All transparent materials show objects the same way because light passes through each of them.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Light: mirrors and lenses. The student must decide: Predict how an object appears when viewed through a convex lens, concave lens, or flat transparent glass piece. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key.
